summary: Tested the 3 BFPO pre-release fixes (urgent alerts, offline engineer work, site photos) in the backend (pytest, 13 passed and 1 skipped in the new file; the existing BFPO suite was re-run with 30/32 passing) and end to end in the UI (desktop staff + mobile engineer, Playwright with context.set_offline). These all work: alert scoping and per-user ack, the staff and engineer banners (View job / X / next alert / +N more), site photo list, streaming and scope 404s, the staff 'Photos from the site (1)' grid, SW registration on /bfpo with /api/bfpo/* cached and job details prefetched, offline reload of Home/Jobs/job detail, the amber offline bar with its counts, queued toasts, the localStorage outbox, auto-flush on the online event (arrive, diagnosis), 'Send now' (complete + signature-unavailable to job closed on the server), and online diagnosis regression. One CRITICAL bug: a parts request with a photo taken offline is LOST on reconnect.

minor.issue: admin@gymaxisai.com gets a different user['id'] on every login (acks stored under ef4b071e, 6e0b38b5, b7632812, 0d1b658d, f6b8a619; none of these is the users-collection id d6fe444a). Master-admin acks therefore only last for one session and the alert comes back after re-login.

Takes the newest 50 matches with .limit(50) and only then removes acked ones. A user who has acked 50+ newer alerts will never see older un-acked ones. Exclude acked ids in the Mongo query ($nin) instead.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL DATA LOSS. A parts request queued offline with a photo is silently dropped on reconnect. RCA: the photo is replayed with fetch(dataUrl), and the app CSP 'connect-src self https: wss: ws:' does not allow data:. The browser refuses ('Fetch API cannot load data:image/jpeg...', TypeError: Failed to fetch). isNetworkError() returns false (navigator.onLine is true and there is no err.code), so the catch treats it as a server rejection and removes the item. Result: no /api/files/upload and no /parts request reach the server, the job stays on_site instead of paused_parts, and the bfpo_blob_* key is left in localStorage forever. Reproduced: diagnosis from the same outbox synced fine, but the parts item vanished.

Any error that is not a network error (5xx, a client-side exception, a 401 from an expired session after a long time without signal) permanently drops the queued update without telling the engineer. Only drop on definitive 4xx rejections (400/404/409/422). Keep the item on 5xx, 401 and unknown errors, and show a 'could not send' notice.

A queued action does not update the job locally. After 'I'm on site' offline, the primary button still says 'I'm on site — Start Job' and reopens the arrive panel. An engineer starting from new/assigned therefore cannot carry on to diagnosis/parts/outcome/complete while offline (and may queue a duplicate arrive or accept). Needs an optimistic local status update, e.g. accept→assigned, arrive→on_site, parts→paused_parts, complete→done.

When the outbox flushes (online event or Send now), the open JobDetail does not reload. It kept showing 'Update Job' after the server had closed the job. Subscribe to onOutboxChange and call load() when the count reaches 0.

integration_issues.issue: index.js registers /sw.js only on a full page load whose path starts with /bfpo, and on any other path (e.g. /MODService) it UNREGISTERS all SWs. Engineers log in at /MODService and SPA-navigate to /bfpo, so the offline cache is not active in that first session until they reload or reopen the app. Signing out (back to /MODService) unregisters the SW again. Suggest registering when the route changes to /bfpo and not unregistering on /MODService (or treating /MODService as a PWA scope).

issues: The existing global dark toast 'You're offline — showing the last cached data.' sits on top of the new amber offline-sync bar and hides its text. Drop one of the two messages or move the toast.
The allocate engineer picker is still a native <select> (existing, not shadcn).

action_items: CRITICAL: in flushOutbox, replace `await (await fetch(dataUrl)).blob()` with a manual base64 decode (atob → Uint8Array → Blob), or add data: to the CSP connect-src (backend/server.py:132 and the ingress CSP). Then retest an offline parts request with a photo.

flushOutbox: only discard items on definitive 4xx responses. Keep them on 5xx, 401 and unknown errors, show the failure in the OfflineSyncBar, and remove the orphaned bfpo_blob_* key when an item is dropped.
Update job status locally (optimistic) after a queued action so engineers can carry out several steps offline. Prevent duplicate accept/arrive being queued.
Reload the open JobDetail (and the Home/Jobs lists) when the outbox finishes flushing.
Register the SW when the SPA reaches /bfpo (not only on a full load), and stop unregistering it on /MODService.
Optional: give master admin a stable id for acks; exclude acked ids in the alerts Mongo query; scope the outbox per user (clear on logout or tag items with user id).
critical_code_review_comments: bfpoApi.js isNetworkError: `!err.response && (...)`. A fetch TypeError, or an axios error without a code, counts as a server rejection and the item is dropped. That is the root cause of the photo loss.

The outbox is global in localStorage and not tied to a user. If an engineer signs out with items queued and another engineer signs in on the same phone, those items are replayed under the second engineer's session.

Storing base64 photos in localStorage (about a 5MB quota) can hit QuotaExceededError. setItem in uploadFile is not wrapped in try/catch, so the upload throws and the parts panel shows nothing. Consider IndexedDB.
UrgentAlertBanner: View job acks the alert immediately (by design). The poll interval restarts whenever `online` changes, which is fine.
Backend: /alerts calls _safe_bridge() on every 30s poll from every client. It is throttled to once per 30s per process, so acceptable.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Engineer flow: open /MODService?portal=modservice and log in through the UI (route-inject the X-RateLimit-Bypass header), reload once so the SW controls the page, open a job via home-job-{id}, then ctx.set_offline(True). The SW caches gymaxis-api-v15 /api/bfpo/*. To test 'Send now', page.route('**/api/bfpo/jobs/**') with abort('internetdisconnected') before going back online, then unroute and click offline-sync-now. To reproduce the photo bug: offline → workflow-opt-parts → set_input_files on parts-photo → parts-submit → go online; no /api/files/upload request is made and the outbox empties. You will need a new P1 seeded case for alert/photo tests, because the old one is deleted.
rca of the issue: Offline parts photo loss: uploadFile stores the compressed image as a dataURL under bfpo_blob_<id>. On flush, fetch(dataURL) is blocked by CSP connect-src (no data:), which throws TypeError 'Failed to fetch'. isNetworkError(e) is false because the browser is online and there is no err.code or err.response, so the catch block treats it as a server rejection and filters the item out. Repro: engineer offline → Parts needed → attach a photo → Request part → go online. Expected: the photo uploads and the job is paused_parts. Actual: the outbox clears, the job stays on_site, and the blob key is orphaned. Fix: decode the base64 without fetch, or allow data: in connect-src, and make the flush keep items on non-4xx failures.
